Explain how a VPN works in simple words
10:42 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet, and everything you send goes through it locked.

Lock: Your device scrambles your data before it leaves, so your Wi-Fi owner or internet provider sees only gibberish.
Tunnel: The scrambled data travels to the VPN company's computer, which unlocks it and sends it on to the website.
Mask: The website sees the VPN computer's address, not yours, so your location looks different.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and hides your browsing from your internet provider. It does not make you anonymous, because the VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust.
